##### Project general facts

PEARLZ Residence is a contemporary residential development by Danube Properties, designed to bring a fresh approach to modern living within a well-established community. The project features a sleek architectural style that blends harmoniously with its surroundings, offering residents a balanced lifestyle with both comfort and connectivity.

The development provides a secure, gated environment complemented by a wide range of lifestyle amenities, creating a convenient and well-rounded living experience. Its strategic location within walking distance of the Al Furjan Metro Station enhances accessibility, making it an ideal choice for those seeking easy commuting while remaining within a спокойная residential setting.

Interiors are designed with stylish elements and a focus on luxury fit and finish, creating a refined and comfortable atmosphere. Apartments are offered without kitchen appliances and are unfurnished, allowing residents full flexibility to design and personalize their living spaces according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
